variants.effectText: Adds Binary mode. The weapon fires 1 shot when the trigger is pressed and 1 shot when it is released. Each shot consumes 1 normal cartridge.

variants.sourceFullName: IWI UZI PRO SMG 9x19 submachine gun
variants.displayName: UZI PRO SMG “Don't Stop Won't Stop”
variants.shortName: UZI PRO SMG Don't Stop Won't Stop
variants.description: The UZI PRO SMG is a submachine gun for law enforcement and military use. This ultra-compact submachine gun is an evolution of the full-size UZI submachine gun, ideal for concealed carry and featuring a high rate of fire. Manufactured by Israel Weapon Industries.
variants.effectText: Every 3rd flesh-damaging hit transfers 1 matching cartridge carried anywhere on the shooter into the current magazine. The cartridge is consumed from inventory; armor hits do not advance the counter.

variants.description: M1A is a civilian version of the M14 rifle designed and manufactured by Springfield Armory, Inc. For the most part, it is identical to the M14. The most notable difference is the removal of the M14's fire selector switch, rendering the rifle permanently semi-automatic. The bayonet lug was also removed from the weapon.
variants.effectText: Adds Binary mode. The weapon fires 1 shot when the trigger is pressed and 1 shot when it is released. Each shot consumes 1 normal cartridge.

variants.description: The Mossberg 500 Series is one of the most famous and widespread pump-action shotguns in the world. Protects your front lawn since 1961.
variants.effectText: Adds Buck-and-Ball mode. Multi-pellet shells fire their normal load plus 1 centered projectile with +50% damage and +100% armor penetration. Slugs and other 1-projectile shells behave normally. Fires 1 shell per trigger pull.

variants.sourceFullName: MPS Auto Assault-12 Gen 1 12ga automatic shotgun
variants.description: The AA-12 (Auto Assault-12) is a reliable full-auto 12-gauge shotgun. The first generation features the high-mounted built-in iron sights. This shotgun is distinguished by its recoil pulse accumulation, which makes the recoil feel smooth without sacrificing fire rate and stopping power. The AA-12 is designed for military and police units. Manufactured by Military Police Systems.
variants.effectText: During uninterrupted fire with a multi-pellet shell, pellet dispersion tightens by 20% per shot, up to −80%. Releasing the trigger resets the bonus. Slugs behave normally.

variants.description: A hunter's dream. A classic double-barrelled beauty, simple and elegant. Fed with 12 gauge shells.
variants.effectText: Replaces the 2-shot firing mode with Buck-and-Ball mode. Multi-pellet shells fire their normal load plus 1 centered projectile with +50% damage and +100% armor penetration. Slugs and other 1-projectile shells behave normally. Fires 1 shell per trigger pull; both barrels can be fired separately.

variants.description: A semi-automatic 12-gauge shotgun with a folding stock, equipped with a firing mechanism safety lock that only allows firing from extended stock position. Features a short 430mm barrel.
variants.effectText: Multi-pellet shells alternate between a narrow pattern with +50% armor penetration and a wide pattern with +50% damage. Slugs behave normally. Resets on reload.

variants.description: A double-barreled sawed-off classic. Ryzhy's personal weapon. Loaded with 12-gauge rounds.
variants.effectText: Replaces the 2-shot firing mode with Final Stand mode. Fires both barrels with +300% recoil and +90% dispersion. Every pellet creates a small impact explosion dealing 15% of that pellet's damage within 1.25 meters.

variants.description: The AK-74M (Avtomat Kalashnikova 74 Modernizirovanny - "Kalashnikov's Automatic rifle 74 Modernized") 5.45x39mm assault rifle is a full-scale produced modernized version of the AK-74 that offers more versatility compared with its predecessor. Apart from several minor improvements, such as a lightened bolt and carrier assembly to reduce the impulse of the gas piston and bolt carrier during firing, the rifle features a new glass-filled polyamide stock that retains the shape of the original AK-74 fixed laminated wood stock, but side-folds to the left like the skeletonised AKS-74 buttstock, and also a dovetail side mount for installing various scopes. The AK-74M is a main service rifle of the Russian Federation.
variants.effectText: While movement input is held, sustained fire gains +6% fire rate per shot after 5 uninterrupted shots, up to +42%. Releasing the trigger or stopping movement resets it.

variants.description: AK-74N (Avtomat Kalashnikova 74 Nochnoy - "Kalashnikov's Automatic rifle 74 Night") was developed in 1970 by M. T. Kalashnikov, became a further evolution of AKM due to adoption of the new 5.45x39 ammunition by the military. The key design difference from the standard AK-74 is a side mount for optical and night scopes.
variants.effectText: Every 5th uninterrupted shot deals +125% damage and receives +50% armor penetration. Releasing the trigger resets the counter.

variants.description: The AK-103 7.62x39mm assault rifle is a further modernized version of AK-74M base. AK-103 is equipped with a side-folding shoulder stock and a side mount for optical and night scopes. The 100-series AKs are produced by the Izhmash factories in Izhevsk, Russia.
variants.effectText: Adds a 2-round burst mode firing at 1,200 RPM. The 2nd cartridge in every burst deals +50% damage.

variants.description: The AK-104 7.62x39mm assault rifle is a further modernized version of AK-74M base, more precisely a shortened version of AK-103. A short compact version equipped with a side-folding shoulder stock and a side mount for optical and night scopes. The 100-series AKs are produced by the Izhmash factories in Izhevsk, Russia.
variants.effectText: Drawing the weapon empowers the next 3 shots with +75% damage and +50% armor penetration. Drawing it again re-arms the effect but does not stack it.

variants.description: The MDR 7.62x51 (.308) bullpup assault rifle, designed and manufactured by Desert Tech LLC. A modular multi-caliber weapon with a compact bullpup layout intended for use by police and military special forces. Barrel lengths and calibers can be changed by the end-user within minutes with a minimum amount of tools.
variants.effectText: Semi-automatic shots receive +60% armor penetration. Full-auto shots receive +35% damage and -30% recoil.

variants.description: The SA58 OSW (Operations Specialist Weapon), manufactured by American company DSA (or DS Arms - David Selvaggio Arms), is a legal copy of the FAL. It's made with the same Steyr-Daimler-Puch production line equipment as the StG-58. It may come with a different barrel length, an aluminum-alloy lower receiver, and improved glass-filled nylon furniture. Civilian models are semi-automatic, but military and law enforcement clients can procure select-fire models that have a fully automatic cyclic rate of 750 rounds/minute. The DSA58 can use any metric-measurement FAL magazines.
variants.effectText: 4 consecutive hits against the same target grant +35% damage for the remainder of the magazine. Missing or changing targets resets the hit counter.

variants.description: The MCX SPEAR is a multi-caliber assault rifle designed and manufactured by SIG Sauer based on the MCX assault rifle. Primarily chambered in the new 6.8x51mm (.277 FURY) ammunition. Designed specifically for the US Military to replace the M4 carbine.
variants.effectText: Striking armor arms the next shot with +100% armor penetration and +50% damage. The charge lasts until fired or reloaded and cannot stack.

variants.description: The Molot OP-SKS Carbine is designed for loading with 7,62x39 — the most popular ammunition. The weight and dimensions make the carbine ergonomic for shooters of any age and height. It has been used for all types of traditional Russian hunting for more than 50 years. Tested on predators in Africa, Southeast Asia, Central America, Middle East.
variants.effectText: Every 6th shot fires 3 projectiles in a symmetrical horizontal spread. Every projectile, including the original, deals 70% damage. Resets on reload.

variants.description: The SR-3M is a powerful assault rifle, featuring a very compact size comparable to submachine guns, but noticeably superior in terms of firepower due to the use of special armor-piercing ammunition. The main purpose of the SR-3M is to be used as a concealed carry weapon for Russian special forces units. Developed at TsNIITochMash and based on the AS VAL assault rifle.
variants.effectText: While the current magazine is at or below 50% capacity, shots receive +50% damage and +30% armor penetration.

variants.description: The VSK-94 (Voyskovoy Snayperskiy Kompleks - "Military Sniper Complex") is a marksman rifle designed on the base of the 9A-91 assault rifle as a cheaper alternative to the VSS "Vintorez". The silencer, unlike the VSS, is not integrated, which allows the rifle to be used without it if needed. Manufactured by Tula KBP Instrument Design Bureau.
variants.effectText: The final 3 cartridges in the weapon each fire 2 overlapping, full-power projectiles.

variants.description: HK MP5K (K from the German word Kurz - "short") is a shorter version of MP5 SMG which was designed for close quarters combat use by clandestine operations and special services.
variants.effectText: In 3-round burst mode, the 3rd cartridge creates an impact explosion dealing 50% of its damage within 1.25 meters. Burst mode fires at 1,200 RPM.

variants.description: MP9-N is the further modification of the MP9 submachine gun, which was refined and optimized in cooperation with special units from police and military. MP9-N is currently in service with close protection teams as well as with SWAT teams worldwide. It is also a perfect choice as a Personal Defense Weapon (PDW).
variants.effectText: After 5 uninterrupted shots, gain +50% fire rate and +25% damage until the trigger is released.

variants.description: FN P90, also known as the FN Project 1990, is a compact personal defense weapon (PDW) designed and manufactured by FN Herstal in Belgium. Created in response to NATO requests for a replacement for 9x19mm Parabellum firearms, the P90 was designed as a compact but powerful firearm for vehicle crews, operators of crew-served weapons, support personnel, special forces, and counter-terrorist groups.
variants.effectText: While the current magazine is above 50% capacity, shots receive +50% armor penetration. At or below 50% capacity, shots receive +50% damage instead.

variants.description: The Heckler & Koch UMP submachine gun was designed by the German company Heckler & Koch in the 1990s as a lighter and cheaper analog to the MP5. This version is designed to fire a .45 ACP cartridge and has a reduced fire rate of 600 rpm.
variants.effectText: The final 4 cartridges receive +100% damage and guarantee a heavy bleed when they inflict flesh damage.

variants.sourceFullName: U.S. Ordnance M60E6 7.62x51 light machine gun
variants.description: The M60E6 is a 7.62x51 caliber light machine gun, a lightweight modification of the M60E4. The M60 was nicknamed "The Pig" due to its bulky size and design flaws. Despite its disadvantages, variants of the M60 are still used in some military units. Manufactured by U.S. Ordnance.
variants.effectText: While moving and firing continuously, dispersion decreases by 10% per shot after 5 uninterrupted shots, up to -70%. Releasing the trigger or stopping movement resets it.

variants.description: The Degtyarev hand-held machine gun chambered in 7.62x39 caliber. This machine gun was adopted by the Soviet Army and was used as a means of reinforcing infantry squads and platoons from the late forties to the early sixties. The RPD is elegantly designed, resulting in a compact, reliable and quite powerful fire support weapon. Manufactured by V.A. Degtyarev Plant.
variants.effectText: Every 10th shot fires 5 projectiles in a symmetrical horizontal sweep. Every projectile, including the original, deals 70% damage. Resets on reload.

variants.description: RPK-16 (Ruchnoy Pulemyot Kalashnikova 16 - "Kalashnikov's Hand-held machine gun 16) is the newest Russian light machine gun chambered in 5.45x39mm rounds. Some key features of this new weapon are the quickly detachable barrels, enhanced ergonomics, and weaver rails on the handguard and dust cover.
variants.effectText: After 5 uninterrupted shots, damage increases by 5% with every subsequent shot, up to +75%. Releasing the trigger resets the bonus.

variants.description: The HK G28 rifle was developed by Heckler & Koch specifically for the Bundeswehr as a support weapon for small infantry units. The G28 is based on the HK MR308, which, in turn, is a civilian version of the HK 417 automatic rifle. Despite several differences, the HK G28 is 75% interchangeable with the HK 417. This rifle is designed to shoot at distances inaccessible to standard 5.56mm assault rifles.
variants.effectText: Remaining stationary while aiming for 4 seconds arms the next shot to fire 2 overlapping, full-power projectiles. Moving or leaving ADS before firing cancels the charge.

variants.description: The Remington Semi Automatic Sniper System is the culmination of a joint effort between Remington Arms and JP Enterprises to develop a highly accurate and superbly built rapid firing sniper rifle. This weapon delivers sub-MOA accuracy out to 800 meters and beyond while providing the tactical advantage of a semi-automatic platform.
variants.effectText: Every consecutive hit against the same target increases the next shot's damage by 25%, up to +100%. Missing, changing targets, or reloading resets it.

variants.description: The SVDS (Snáyperskaya Vintóvka Dragunóva Skladnáya - "Dragunov's Sniper Rifle with a foldable stock") sniper rifle was specially designed for Russian paratroopers and special forces units. Features a tubular metal stock that folds to the right side of the receiver (equipped with a synthetic shoulder pad and a fixed cheek riser) and a synthetic pistol grip. The barrel was also given a heavier profile, the receiver housing was strengthened, the gas cylinder block was improved and a ported, shorter conical flash suppressor was adopted. Chambered in 7.62x54R ammo.
variants.effectText: Every 3rd consecutive hit against the same target deals +150% damage and guarantees a heavy bleed on flesh damage. Missing, changing targets, or reloading resets the counter.

variants.sourceFullName: Accuracy International AXMC .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle
variants.description: The AXMC is the latest in a long and distinguished line of combat proven sniper rifles designed and manufactured by the British company Accuracy International. Chambered in .338 Lapua Magnum, but can be quickly converted to .300 Winchester Magnum and .308 Winchester by changing the barrel, bolt, and magazine/insert.
variants.effectText: Drawing the weapon arms the next shot with +150% damage and +100% armor penetration. It re-arms after the weapon is holstered and drawn again but cannot stack.

variants.sourceFullName: Lobaev Arms DVL-10 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle
variants.description: DVL-10 is a lightweight, compact, and silenced rifle in proprietary and current military subsonic calibers. Developed for special service and combat missions where exceptional accuracy and range are needed. Equipped with a standard Lobaev Arms foldable buttstock and Lobaev Hummer Barrels stainless steel match-grade barrel.
variants.effectText: Remaining stationary while aiming for 4 seconds arms the next shot with +100% damage and +75% armor penetration. Moving or leaving ADS cancels the charge.

variants.description: The Remington Model 700 is a series of bolt-action centerfire rifles manufactured by Remington Arms since 1962.
variants.effectText: A successful hit arms the next shot to fire 2 overlapping, full-power projectiles. The charge is consumed by the next shot regardless of whether it hits.

variants.description: The M3 S90 is a dual-mode shotgun designed and manufactured by Benelli. The M3 is notable for allowing the user to choose between semi-automatic or pump-action operation. Benelli shotguns show excellent ballistic performance, and the finish and fine workmanship are the epitome of traditional Italian style.
variants.effectText: In pump-action mode, pellets receive +60% armor penetration. In semi-automatic mode, the weapon receives -50% dispersion and -40% recoil.

variants.description: KS-23 is a Russian shotgun, although because it uses a rifled barrel it is officially designated by the Russian military as a carbine. KS stands for Karabin Spetsialniy, "Special Carbine". It is renowned for its large caliber, firing a 23 mm round, equating to 6.27 gauge using the British and American standards of shotgun gauges and approximately 4 gauge using the current European standards (based on the metric CIP tables), making it the largest-bore shotgun in use today.
variants.effectText: Every 3rd shell multiplies its normal pellet count by 2. Every pellet deals 70% damage. Only ammunition that naturally fires multiple pellets qualifies; 1-projectile shells behave normally. Resets on reload.

variants.description: MTs-255-12 is a unique for Russian market 12 gauge revolver shotgun.
variants.effectText: Successive cylinder shots receive +25%, +50%, +75%, +100%, and +125% damage. The 5th shot also creates an impact explosion dealing 50% of its damage within 1.5 meters. The sequence then restarts.

variants.description: A single-barreled 20 gauge hunting shotgun with a sliding breech bolt. Widely known by it vernacular name, the Death of the Chairman, for its compact size.
variants.effectText: The final cartridge fires 4 total projectiles in a tight randomized spread. Every projectile, including the original, deals 70% damage.

variants.description: Glock 17 is an Austrian pistol designed by Glock company for the Austrian army purposes. Thanks to both its impressive combat characteristics and reliablity it gained wide recognition and popularity as a police, shooting sports and civilian self-defense weapon.
variants.effectText: Consecutive hits to the same body part increase the next shot's damage by 25%, up to +100%. Striking a different body part, missing, or reloading resets the bonus.

variants.description: The Beretta M9A3 is the newest addition to the M9 series of pistols. It was designed for military and police forces, as well as for sport and a home defense use. The main features of the A3 generation are a more ergonomic and durable FDE coating.
variants.effectText: Every 9th shot deals +200% damage and guarantees a heavy bleed when it inflicts flesh damage. Resets on reload.

variants.description: The powerful RSh-12 (Revolver Shturmovoy 12 - "Assault Revolver 12") revolver, manufactured by KBP Instrument Design Bureau, designed for use by special forces. Despite the powerful 12.7x55 mm caliber, RSh-12 has less recoil than many other large-caliber revolvers and pistols, since the shot is fired from the bottom chamber of the cylinder.
variants.effectText: Adds High Noon mode. 1 trigger pull rapidly fires every remaining cartridge in the cylinder at 900 RPM. Recoil is reduced by 75% while High Noon mode is selected.

variants.description: The powerful RSh-12 (Revolver Shturmovoy 12 - "Assault Revolver 12") revolver, manufactured by KBP Instrument Design Bureau, designed for use by special forces. Despite the powerful 12.7x55 mm caliber, RSh-12 has less recoil than many other large-caliber revolvers and pistols, since the shot is fired from the bottom chamber of the cylinder.
variants.effectText: Every shot deals +75% damage and gains +50% penetration. The final round in the cylinder instead deals +150% damage and gains +75% penetration.

variants.description:
ER FULCRUM BAYONET.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

Following on from the successful FULCRUM knife, Extrema Ratio developed a bayonet version of that design. Like the original FULCRUM, this bayonet is extremely versatile and strong. The tanto-shaped blade allows for large amounts of work and wear while still keeping a sharp edge at its exceedingly sturdy tip. This feature, combined with a sharp false edge, makes the knife retain sufficient combat penetration capability to engage targets covered in heavy clothing, padding, or soft ballistic protections. Thanks to its weight and top-heavy balancing, the FULCRUM BAYONET blade is suitable for hard work on the field.
variants.effectText: Stabs deal +200% damage.

variants.displayName: Bars A-2607 Damascus knife “Run Faster with a Knife”
variants.description:
Bars A-2607 Damascus knife.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

The Bars A-2607 knife, forged of Damascus steel with a wenge handle and brass guard.
variants.effectText: +30% movement speed.

variants.description:
Bars A-2607 95Kh18 knife.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

The Bars A-2607 knife, forged of 95Kh18 steel with a fine wood handle and brass guard.
variants.effectText: Stabs that damage flesh inflict Heavy Bleeding.

variants.description:
6Kh5 Bayonet.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

The so-called "Item 6Kh5" is a bayonet knife adopted in 1989 as a standard-issue for use with AK-74 assault rifles.
variants.effectText: With an AK-74-family rifle equipped in either primary slot: +200% melee damage, +100% draw and holster speed for this bayonet, and +10% movement speed.

variants.description:
Cultist knife.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

A knife of a strange shape and with strange signs, taken from the cultists. Seems like it is used as a ritual knife, but apparently it's not limited to this use. It has technological changes in the design intended for the use of toxic substances - it's better not to touch the blade.
variants.effectText: Melee attacks from behind deal +666% damage. Movement and equipment noise are reduced by 30%.

variants.description:
Akula push dagger.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

As dangerous as the fish it's named after.
variants.effectText: +250% damage against targets already suffering Light or Heavy Bleeding.

variants.displayName: United Cutlery M48 Tactical Kukri “Red Tide”
variants.description:
United Cutlery M48 Tactical Kukri.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

A 48 series tactical kukri manufactured by United Cutlery. Features a stainless steel blade and rubberized handle. A great addition to every survivalist's arsenal!
variants.effectText: Each attack that damages flesh adds +25% damage to following attacks, up to +300%. Switching away resets the bonus.

variants.displayName: Kiba Arms Tactical Tomahawk “Swiss Army Axe”
variants.description:
Kiba Arms Tactical Tomahawk.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

A tactical tomahawk, multitool and breaching tool, all-in-one solution.
variants.effectText: +75% slash and stab damage. +75% melee attack speed.

variants.displayName: SOG Voodoo Hawk tactical tomahawk “Blood Bank”
variants.description:
SOG Voodoo Hawk tactical tomahawk.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

SOG has combined its three best features: an extended cutting head, compact glass-reinforced nylon handle, and a metal butt cap on the end.
variants.effectText: Each attack that damages flesh restores up to 10 total HP across injured living body parts. Does not restore destroyed body parts.

variants.description:
Antique axe.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

An antique axe with a damaged handle that belonged to the ancient clan of hatchlings called WYCC.
variants.effectText: Every 3rd melee attack deals +300% damage. Misses count. Switching away resets the counter.

variants.description:
Crash Axe.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

Designed as a tool for working with hard surfaces. Materials and construction are designed to provide optimal impact and strength. The head of the axe is made of 6AL4V titanium with a thickness of 2.85 inches.
variants.effectText: +50 melee penetration on slashes and stabs.

variants.description:
SP-8 Survival Machete.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

SP-8 is a survival machete made of a single piece of high carbon steel. Manufactured by Ontario Knife Company.
variants.effectText: At 40% or less total health: +125% melee damage and 15% less incoming enemy damage.

variants.description:
UVSR Taiga-1 survival machete.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

UVSR "Device for carrying out rescue operations" Taiga-1. A truly versatile survival tool. It is a weapon and a shovel and an axe and everything you can imagine. It was developed and produced in the USSR for various agencies.
variants.effectText: +100% melee damage while holding movement controls at impact.

variants.description:
Camper axe.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

A universal travel axe for use in field conditions or in household. Also works as a melee weapon if things get too desperate.
variants.effectText: +20% movement speed. Sprinting consumes 40% less Leg Stamina.

variants.description:
Red Rebel ice pick.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

A perfectly balanced ice axe, the tip is made of a single piece of hardened metal.
variants.effectText: Jumping consumes 60% less Leg Stamina. Sprinting consumes 25% less Leg Stamina.

variants.description:
MPL-50 entrenching tool.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

MPL-50 (Malaya Pekhotnaya Lopata 50 - "Small Infantry Spade 50") is a small spade invented by a Danish officer Mads Johan Buch Linnemann in 1869. While nominally an entrenching tool, MPL-50 saw a wide range of wartime applications ranging from a close quarters combat weapon to a cooking utensil.
variants.effectText: +150% damage to legs. Attacks that damage leg flesh cause a fracture.

variants.description:
Freeman crowbar.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

A reliable steel crowbar manufactured by Freeman company. Caution! May lead to Resonance Cascade.
variants.effectText: +25% jump height and +10% movement speed. Immune to fall damage while this crowbar is held when landing.

variants.description:
PR-Taran police baton.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

The PR-Taran baton with side handle is used by law enforcement agencies for protection and crowd control.
variants.effectText: +33% melee damage and +33% melee attack speed. Melee kills immediately restore 33% of maximum Leg Stamina, capped at full.

variants.sourceFullName: Miller Bros. Blades M-2 Tactical Sword
variants.displayName: Miller Bros. Blades M-2 Tactical Sword “Long Arm of the Blade”
variants.description:
Miller Bros. Blades M-2 Tactical Sword.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

The "M-2" short tactical sword, manufactured by Miller Bros. Blades.
variants.effectText: +35% melee reach. Slashes deal +50% damage.

variants.displayName: APOK Tactical Wasteland Gladius “Entertaining The Masses”
variants.description:
APOK Tactical Wasteland Gladius.

All legendary bonuses apply only while this melee weapon is held.

The Tactical Wasteland Gladius sword, manufactured by APOK. Arena champion's prime melee weapon. Rumors are that this is the exact blade that the gladiator Voron used to fight with. Or at least it looks like one.
variants.effectText: Melee kills restore 50% of maximum Leg Stamina, capped at full, and up to 50 total HP across injured living body parts. Does not restore destroyed body parts.

The Bars A-2607 knife, forged of Damascus steel with a wenge handle and brass guard.

6Kh5 Bayonet.

The painkiller effect persists after switching weapons.

The so-called "Item 6Kh5" is a bayonet knife adopted in 1989 as a standard-issue for use with AK-74 assault rifles.

variants.description: A cheap replica of some 3-day assault pack with a MOLLE attachment system, adapted and enhanced by the owner as much as their creativity allowed. Does not offer much comfort, and volume is far lower than that of a proper 3-day pack, but it's still a backpack alright.
variants.effectText: +100% search speed when searching a corpse.

variants.description: A cheap replica of some 3-day assault pack with a MOLLE attachment system, adapted and enhanced by the owner as much as their creativity allowed. Does not offer much comfort, and volume is far lower than that of a proper 3-day pack, but it's still a backpack alright.
variants.effectText: Loading and unloading magazines is 2 times as fast.

variants.description: An original sling bag for everyday wear or for active rest.
variants.effectText: With a pistol drawn and no primary firearm equipped, forward ground jumps travel 40% farther horizontally. Jump height and Leg Stamina cost stay normal.

variants.description: The TT Trooper Light Pack 35 is a lightweight and functional 35 liter backpack from Tasmanian Tiger with a comfortable and ergonomic PaddenBack suspension system and anatomical shoulder straps.
variants.effectText: Perform 2 different Leg Stamina-consuming actions within 5 seconds: refund 20% of the 2nd action's cost. Sprint, jump and vault qualify. For sprinting, the refund covers only the 1st 5 seconds. Already free actions give no refund.

variants.description: This backpack is a multifunctional piece of equipment designed for transportation of various items of combat and marching equipment, additional weaponry, etc. It can be used both as part of the UMTBS transportation and gear system (ZhTU 6Sh112) and independently, as part of various sets of individual combat equipment.
variants.effectText: With an item in each of this bag's 6 compartments, the held weapon settles after firing 30% faster. Emptying any compartment ends the bonus.

variants.description: This backpack is a multifunctional piece of equipment designed for transportation of various items of combat and marching equipment, additional weaponry, etc. It can be used both as part of the UMTBS transportation and gear system (ZhTU 6Sh112) and independently, as part of various sets of individual combat equipment.
variants.effectText: Complete 1 chamber check, 1 magazine check and 1 inspection on the same firearm, in any order: searches reveal their 1st item instantly for 180 seconds. The checklist clears after activation; removing the bag clears unfinished steps.

variants.description: A rather spacious messenger bag, large enough to fit a lunchbox, laptop and some papers - or a small emergency survival kit. Its transformable sling and universal size allow it to be worn both as bag and a compact backpack.
variants.effectText: Eating and drinking is 2 times as fast.

variants.description: Included in the all-season basic equipment kit (VKBO). Designed for transportation and storage of personal items of soldiers.
variants.effectText: Exhausting your Leg Stamina immediately restores 75% of maximum Leg Stamina. Cooldown: 180 seconds, shared across copies.

variants.displayName: Vertx Ready Pack backpack (Red) “Da Red Goez Fasta”
variants.description: A tactical (but not overly tactical) everyday carry 20L backpack made by Vertx. Red color version.
variants.effectText: +30% walking speed, +40% sprint speed and 100% higher sprint Leg Stamina consumption. Movement and item-use sounds are 2 times as loud; gunshots are unchanged.

variants.displayName: WARTECH Berkut BB-102 backpack (A-TACS FG) “Quiet Cargo”
variants.description: A tactical backpack with front loading capabilities. Suitable for use by military and security forces, or for military tactical games. Manufactured in WARTECH.
variants.effectText: Searching containers and moving inventory items produces 50% less sound while this bag is worn. Footsteps and weapon sounds remain normal.

variants.displayName: WARTECH Berkut BB-102 backpack (A-TACS FG) “Tetris Master”
variants.description: A tactical backpack with front loading capabilities. Suitable for use by military and security forces, or for military tactical games. Manufactured in WARTECH.
variants.effectText: Completely filling this bag's main compartment grants +15% movement speed. The bonus ends as soon as any cell becomes empty.

variants.sourceFullName: ANA Tactical Alpha chest rig (Olive Drab)
variants.displayName: ANA Tactical Alpha chest rig (Olive Drab) “Chad Workout”
variants.description: "Alpha" is a high-quality chest rig that fully meets the military standards for reliability and functionality. The combination of integrated pouches and MOLLE straps provides the means of carrying a large number of necessary equipment. The vest is designed as a classic chest rig. variants.effectText: Going prone grants +25% sprint speed and +25% jump height for 15 seconds. Going prone again refreshes both bonuses.

variants.description: The Type 56 Chicom vest is the forefather of modern tactical loadout harness systems. The Type 56 rifle magazine chest harness was developed for the People's Liberation Army of China in the 1950s and has since been widely used in many local conflicts of the 20th century. In the early 1980s, such harnesses made their way to Afghanistan, where they gained acceptance by select Soviet troops who used the trophy Chicoms. It is unknown whether or not the Chicom served as a prototype for the Soviet Belt-A chest rig or not.
variants.effectText: For rifles with internal magazines, checking the chamber grants +40% penetration power for the remaining loaded cartridges. Ends when the rifle is reloaded.

variants.description: The Universal Modular Transport-Combat System (UMTBS) "Scout-Sniper" is officially part of the equipment of the armed forces of the Russian Federation. The vest is designed with a modular approach and can be transformed to suit various specific combat tasks. This system includes the vest base, various purpose pouches, and backpacks. Due to the fact that the vest is based on the MOLLE system, it can be used with various compatible pouches beyond those included with the kit. The belt system has soft bumper pads, and its inside is made from breathable materials.
variants.effectText: After staying aimed through a magnified optic for 4 seconds, gain -40% MOA and -60% aim sway until you lower the weapon. Moving resets the 4-second buildup.

variants.displayName: Ars Arma CPC MOD.1 plate carrier (A-TACS FG) “Primary Care”
variants.description: The first generation of the modified CPC plate carrier originally designed by Crye Precision and adapted by Ars Arma for use by special forces of the Russian Federation. This modular body armor is based on a polymer harness that fits the thorax, which avoids the plate carrier backlash during active movement and also contributes to a more even distribution of weight. Made in the assault configuration of pouches. Manufactured by Ars Arma.
variants.effectText: Medkits spend 25% fewer resource points when restoring HP. Each use still spends at least 1 resource point. Bleed treatment, surgery, and fracture-treatment costs are unchanged.

variants.displayName: Eagle Industries MMAC plate carrier (Ranger Green) “Minimum Fuss”
variants.description: The Eagle Industries Multi-Mission Tactical Vest (MMAC) is a traditional profile vest offering modularity and scalability. The tactical vest is constructed of MIL-SPEC 500 denier nylon and is fully MOLLE/PALS compatible. It features padded shoulders with detachable retention loops, push-to-talk (PTT) attachment points at upper left and right chest and many other features.
variants.effectText: With a firearm whose full loaded capacity is 10 cartridges or fewer, checking the chamber grants +40% damage for its current loaded cartridges. Capacity includes chambered rounds. Reloading ends the bonus.

variants.description: The Eagle Industries Multi-Mission Tactical Vest (MMAC) is a traditional profile vest offering modularity and scalability. The tactical vest is constructed of MIL-SPEC 500 denier nylon and is fully MOLLE/PALS compatible. It features padded shoulders with detachable retention loops, push-to-talk (PTT) attachment points at upper left and right chest and many other features.
variants.effectText: Completing an emergency reload empowers 10 shots on that firearm. Each of those shots  has -90% recoil. Reloading replaces any unused charges.

variants.displayName: ECLiPSE RBAV-AF plate carrier (Ranger Green) “Damage Control”
variants.description: The BAE ECLiPSE RBAV (Releasable Body Armor Vest, Air Force) variant is designed specifically for the Guardian Angel Weapon System (USAF PJ) and contains several new features not found in other versions.
variants.effectText: Gain 5% combat damage resistance per blacked arm, leg, or stomach, up to 25%. Removes blacked-arm handling penalties and blacked-leg movement restrictions. Sprinting on blacked legs still causes normal injury damage. Fall and bleed damage are unchanged.

variants.sourceFullName: First Spear Strandhogg plate carrier (Ranger Green)
variants.displayName: First Spear Strandhogg plate carrier (Ranger Green) “Boarding Party”
variants.description: Taking its name from an Old Norse Viking term for a lightning raid, Strandhögg was one of the first formalized battle tactics to use covert infiltrators in advance of an actual raiding operation. Strandhögg was a tactical game-changer in its time, just like the technological advances First Spear is bringing forward in this line of plate carriers.
variants.effectText: Successfully breaching a closed door with a kick grants -50% hip-fire spread and +40% firearm switching speed for 25 seconds. 25-second cooldown.

variants.displayName: NPP KlASS Bagariy plate carrier (EMR) “Port Authority”
variants.description: In the second millennium, the equipment of a soldier received serious changes in view of new threats and tasks. A better level of protection was required, so the Russian army needed a reliable and functional body armor. In the mid-2000s, the MVD, which was later reorganized into the Russian Guard, received Bagariy bulletproof vests. Bagariy was used both by ordinary soldiers of the internal troops, and in special forces. Actively was used by PMC BEAR as the main heavy body armor.
variants.effectText: Adds a separate 3x4 compartment for firearms, including their attached parts and loaded ammunition. Loose items cannot be stored there. +25% Arm and Leg Stamina regeneration.
